item.text:
It provides order calculations: item totals, code discounts, an “average,” and formatted receipts.

Bugs:
- `calcTotal` loops through `i <= items.length`; final access is `undefined`, causing a crash. Use `i < items.length`. [test/orders.js](C:\Users\Kerim\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-eco-bench-KlkLMw\test\orders.js:5)
- `averageItemPrice` returns `Infinity`/`NaN` for an empty list. [test/orders.js](C:\Users\Kerim\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-eco-bench-KlkLMw\test\orders.js:21)
- Its average divides total line cost by number of lines, not total quantity—incorrect if “item price” means per unit.
